subject: Application for Senior Platform Engineer
paragraphs: I am excited to apply for the Senior Platform Engineer role at Acme Robotics. Over the past seven years I have built and operated high-traffic systems in Go and TypeScript, most recently leading the migration of a 400k-line monolith to fourteen services on Kubernetes at Northwind Analytics, which cut p95 latency by 48% and saved $310k a year in infrastructure costs.

What draws me to Acme is the challenge of running reliable software next to real hardware. Your posting emphasises observability and safe, frequent deploys; at Brightline Health I took our release cadence from weekly to more than twenty deploys a day by rebuilding CI/CD on GitHub Actions and Terraform, and I maintain tracekit, an open-source OpenTelemetry toolkit used by more than forty companies.

I also care about the people side of platform work. I have mentored five engineers, introduced design reviews that halved production incidents, and I enjoy partnering with product teams so the platform solves their real problems rather than imagined ones.
I would welcome the chance to discuss how I can help Acme's platform team scale with the fleet. Thank you for your time and consideration.
